subject: Embeddings endpoint: latency spike after model promotion — customer impact & mitigation
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@deltaanalytics.com>
To: support@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: sudden spike in embeddings latency since this morning

Hi Redwood support team,

We started seeing large P95/P99 regressions on the hosted embeddings endpoint this morning right after a model promotion activity. P99 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s and p95 is hovering around 600-800ms. This is impacting our vector search and recommendation freshness.

I attached a couple of latency heatmaps and the support ticket logs (support_ticket_48721.pdf). Traffic profile hasn't changed from our side; requests are identical to yesterday. Can someone confirm if a catalog/model promotion went live around 09:10 PDT?

Impact: degraded search quality & slower response times for product recommendations.

Please advise next steps — need ETA for mitigation or rollback.

Thanks,
Alex Moreno
Head of Data Platform
Delta Analytics

Thanks Camila — quick triage below.

Observations:
- Correlated timestamp: model catalog promotion recorded at 09:10:03 PDT (model-id: model-emb-v3-q8-promote) in deployment logs.
- Metrics: embeddings-hosted.prod // p95 jumped from ~140ms -> ~680ms; p99 from ~120ms -> ~1.82s for the affected shard pool.
- Error rate: small uptick in 502s (~0.4%) coincident with high tail latency but not primary.
- Traffic: client request rate unchanged. No config change on Delta's side.

Immediate ask from SRE: can we pin traffic for Delta to the previous model variant (model-emb-v3-q4) while we investigate kernel/quantization path? I also want a kernel-level trace for the promoted variant; Aditya, can you pull the perf traces for the new quantized kernels?

I'm putting an ops P0 watch on this — will notify if rollback is required.

-neha

Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: sudden spike in embeddings latency since this morning

Quick notes from infra/serving side. I pulled a subset perf trace: the new q8 execution path shows higher kernel stalls for short sequences (<=64 tokens) because of unexpected branch on attention optimization. That increases tail latency even though throughput for longer sequences looks fine.

Short-term mitigations we can execute immediately (low-risk):
1) Pin Delta's routing to model-emb-v3-q4 (previous quantization) — immediate effect, no code change.
2) Re-route a fraction (20%) of hosted traffic to warm fallback pool running v3-q4 to validate improvement before full switchover.
3) If permission granted, rollback catalog promotion for the affected shard pool (canary rollback) — I attached runbook_patch.md with steps and the safe rollback command.

I recommend option 1+2 now while we put a patch in the kernel selection path (takes ~3 hours to validate).

Aditya Rao
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime

Alex — thanks for reporting this so quickly and apologies for the impact. We're seeing the same correlation internally: a model promotion pushed a q8 quantized variant at ~09:10 PDT which looks like the likely trigger for the p95/p99 regressions you're seeing.

Planned immediate actions (can start now with your approval):
- Pin your traffic to the previous variant (model-emb-v3-q4) and route 20% to the fallback pool while we validate (expected improvement visible within 10m).
- If you prefer, we can do a full rollback of the promotion for your traffic only (canary rollback) — this requires your authorization to touch routing for the account.

As a gesture for the disruption: we can apply a service credit for the hours affected. Laura (CS lead) is looped for the credit/contract side.

Can you confirm "go ahead" for the pin+partial reroute or if you want a full rollback? ETA for pin+reroute is ~10–15 minutes once we have signoff.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
